summary: Rebuilt the engine's money lines and option rules (L1-L7, L14-L17) on lib/pricing/engine.ts. Each work item is priced from its own cost (cost x (1 + overhead) / (1 - target margin), rounded down to the dollar), so the same work costs the same in every option; the rest of the model price is a 'Travel and setup' line, the minimum job top-up a 'Minimum job charge' line and an estimator's price a 'Price adjustment' line. CustomerItem.kind is 'work' | 'travel' | 'minimum' | 'adjustment'; every line is whole dollars and the lines add up to the price. Price overrides round to the dollar, the price step is at least $1 (engine and price advice), and an override under $1 is ignored with an override_too_low warning (Apply waits for $1 or more). Install labor follows a changed quantity (model hours unchanged). OD6: priceEstimate(input, snapshot, coeffs, opts?: { showAll }) leaves out duplicates and options that do not step up, each with an option_hidden warning; stepUp and workSignature are exported. Titles and bullets come from the work priced; air-sealing words per job type; areas under 10 sq ft keep one decimal. Callers: the phone's option cards list each line with its price; the quote document carries each line's kind and never recommends an option it does not carry; the customer page shows job lines without an empty area label; the design sheet keeps three sample options; service worker cache v6 so phones load the new engine. The phone and the server call the same priceEstimate with the same defaults, so the prices the phone sends with a quote equal the ones the server stores. Every record example reproduces with today's seeded pricing except L2 (its numbers need the dense-pack bag from L20; with that coverage the engine gives the record's exact $1,254 + $186 + $60) and L4 (the record's random quote is not re-runnable; a seeded example is in the ledger).

notesForNextStage: API: priceEstimate(input, snapshot, coeffs, opts?: { showAll?: boolean }); exports stepUp, workSignature, priceStep, PriceEstimateOptions, CUSTOMER_ITEM_KINDS, CustomerItemKind. Warnings added: option_hidden, override_too_low. Job-level customer items have areaId null and areaName ''. QuoteOptionDoc.items[].kind is optional: quotes sent before it have none, read missing as 'work'. Money: work = floor(money(cost x markup)); travel = roundUp(loaded / (1 - m), priceStep) - sum(work); minimum = adjustedPrice - that; adjustment = price - adjustedPrice. Labels/bullets: optionText/areaLabel/areaBullets in engine.ts; AreaWork.primary.finalR is the R reached, a hook for L23's 'Fills the full cavity'. Primary item description text is unchanged except sq ft formatting (L17). Tests on seeded pricing use lib/pricing/__fixtures__/migrationSeed.ts (seededSnapshot, seededCoefficients, seededArea, seededEstimate), generated from a fresh migrated database through lib/server/snapshot makeBundle; when the checker's seeded.ts lands, phase1.test.ts can switch to it and this file can go. The hand fixture (seed.ts) cellulose is $22. Math tests wrap priceEstimate with showAll. public/sw.js is v6: if another branch bumps it, take the higher value and bump once more. Environment: a symlinked node_modules in a worktree makes the Turbopack build fail ('Could not find the Next.js package'); a hard-linked copy (cp -al ../koala-estimator/node_modules node_modules) works.
